title: Water-positive campus with a county road fund
pitch: Closed-loop cooling keeps the campus off the county's water supply, and a share of the project's tax contribution goes to a dedicated fund for rural road repair.
commitments: Closed-loop cooling with near-zero water draw
Annual county road-repair fund, sized to the project's tax contribution
Public quarterly report on water and road spending

title: Aquifer monitoring and a school technical program
pitch: An independent, public aquifer-monitoring network answers the community's top concern directly, paired with a technical-education partnership with local schools.
commitments: Funded public aquifer-monitoring network with an open data dashboard
Technical-education partnership with local high schools

title: Grid-powered campus with local job training
pitch: No on-site gas turbines: the campus draws grid power with battery backup, avoiding the emissions and noise behind past local backlash, and funds a job-training program.
commitments: No on-site combustion generation; battery backup only
Independent air-quality monitoring near the site
Skilled-trades training program with local colleges

title: Corridor campus with traffic and school investments
pitch: Construction and shift traffic is routed off residential roads, with funding for intersection upgrades and new school capacity tied to the project's tax revenue.
commitments: Traffic management plan with intersection upgrades
School-capacity contribution tied to tax revenue
Sound walls and low-noise cooling on residential edges
